name: cryoshield-vault-v1
encoding: All byte strings are lowercase hex. Integers are JSON numbers.

vaults.name: any-of-3
vaults.description: Mode 0x01, keys A+B+C (C has a 48-byte credential ID).

vaults.name: any-of-2-max
vaults.description: Mode 0x01, keys A+B, secret of exactly maxPayloadBytes (638); padding granularity makes the blob 974 bytes.

vaults.name: any-of-2-12-word
vaults.description: Mode 0x01, keys A+B, 12-word seed phrase: same blob length as any-of-2 (24 words).
vaults.secretUtf8: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about

vaults.name: any-of-3-12-word
vaults.secretUtf8: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about

vaults.name: any-of-3-24-word
vaults.secretUtf8: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon art

vaults.name: shamir-2-of-3-12-word

vaults.secretUtf8: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about

vaults.name: shamir-2-of-3-24-word

vaults.secretUtf8: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon art

lengthHidingCases.name: any-of-2
lengthHidingCases.description: Mode 0x01, keys A+B: a 12-word seed, a 24-word seed and a 638-byte secret.

lengthHidingCases.name: any-of-3
lengthHidingCases.description: Mode 0x01, keys A+B+C: a 12-word seed, a 24-word seed and TOTP codes.

lengthHidingCases.name: shamir-2-of-3
lengthHidingCases.description: Mode 0x02, 2-of-3 over A+B+C: a 12-word seed, a 24-word seed and a 28-byte phrase.

legacyPaddingCases.name: legacy-any-of-2
legacyPaddingCases.description: The previous any-of-2 vault blob (64-byte padding steps).

legacyPaddingCases.name: legacy-any-of-3
legacyPaddingCases.description: The previous any-of-3 vault blob (64-byte padding steps).

legacyPaddingCases.name: legacy-any-of-2-max
legacyPaddingCases.description: The previous any-of-2-max vault blob (64-byte padding steps).

legacyPaddingCases.name: legacy-shamir-2-of-3
legacyPaddingCases.description: The previous shamir-2-of-3 vault blob (64-byte padding steps).

legacyPaddingCases.name: legacy-add-C-with-A
legacyPaddingCases.description: The previous add-C-with-A result (3 keys, 64-byte padding steps), opened with C.

legacyPaddingCases.name: legacy-update-with-B
legacyPaddingCases.description: The previous update-with-B result (64-byte padding steps), opened with A.

decodeCases.name: truncated-last-byte
decodeCases.description: Blob with the final byte removed.

decodeCases.name: truncated-header
decodeCases.description: Blob cut to its first 20 bytes.

decodeCases.name: oversize-blob
decodeCases.description: The max vault with one extra 64-byte payload block (1038 bytes > 1024).

decodeCases.name: duplicate-cred-id
decodeCases.description: Entry B's credential ID replaced by entry A's.

openCases.name: unknown-cred-id
openCases.description: Key A's PRF but key D's credential ID.

openCases.name: tampered-header-rpid
openCases.description: One rpId byte flipped (inside every wrap AAD).

openCases.name: tampered-wrapped-key-own
openCases.description: Entry A's wrapped key flipped, opened with A.

openCases.name: tampered-wrapped-key-other
openCases.description: Entry A's wrapped key flipped, opened with B (payload AAD covers entry A).

openCases.name: swapped-entries
openCases.description: Entries A and B swapped (wrap AAD binds the entry index).

openCases.name: tampered-payload-ct
openCases.description: Last tag byte of the payload flipped.

openCases.name: shamir-C-A
openCases.description: 2-of-3 with keys C and A (given in reverse order).

openCases.name: wrong-vault-id
openCases.description: Genuine any-of-2 blob and key A, but opened under another vaultId (a clone).

openCases.name: shamir-wrong-vault-id
openCases.description: Genuine 2-of-3 blob and keys A+B, but under another vaultId (a clone).

openCases.name: nonzero-pad-byte
openCases.description: Authenticated payload whose last pad byte is 0x01.

openCases.name: length-prefix-overrun
openCases.description: Authenticated payload whose length prefix is the padded length minus 1.

createCases.name: duplicate-prf
createCases.description: Different credential IDs with identical PRF outputs (equal locators).

addKeyCases.name: add-C-with-A
addKeyCases.description: Add key C to any-of-2 using only key A; the payload is re-padded to the 3-key maximum.

addKeyCases.name: add-C-to-legacy
addKeyCases.description: Add key C to the legacy-padded any-of-2 blob (526 bytes) using key A; the result is padded to the 3-key maximum.

addKeyCases.name: add-C-with-wrong-key
addKeyCases.description: Add key C using unenrolled key D.

addKeyCases.name: add-duplicate
addKeyCases.description: Add key B again using key A.

addKeyCases.name: add-to-shamir
addKeyCases.description: Add key D to the 2-of-3 Shamir vault.

addKeyCases.name: add-oversize
addKeyCases.description: Add key C to the any-of-2-max vault: its 638-byte secret exceeds the 3-key maximum (574).

addKeyCases.name: add-ninth-key
addKeyCases.description: Add a 9th key to an 8-key vault.

addKeyCases.name: add-wrong-vault-id
addKeyCases.description: Add key C to the any-of-2 blob under another vaultId (a clone).

updatePayloadCases.name: update-with-B
updatePayloadCases.description: Key B replaces the any-of-2 secret.

updatePayloadCases.name: update-legacy-to-max
updatePayloadCases.description: Key B replaces the secret of the legacy-padded any-of-2 blob (526 bytes) with a 12-word seed; the result is padded to the 2-key maximum (974 bytes).

updatePayloadCases.name: update-wrong-key
updatePayloadCases.description: Unenrolled key D tries to update.

updatePayloadCases.name: update-shamir-A-C
updatePayloadCases.description: Keys A and C update the 2-of-3 secret.

updatePayloadCases.name: update-wrong-vault-id
updatePayloadCases.description: Key B updates the any-of-2 blob under another vaultId (a clone).

updatePayloadCases.name: update-shamir-wrong-vault-id
updatePayloadCases.description: Keys A and C update the 2-of-3 blob under another vaultId (a clone).

selectCases.name: squatted-locator
selectCases.description: Genuine any-of-2 vault after junk and a byte-identical clone under an attacker vaultId, followed by the genuine any-of-3 vault.

selectCases.name: no-genuine-candidate
selectCases.description: Only junk and a clone under an attacker vaultId.

selectCases.name: clone-only
selectCases.description: Only the byte-identical clone under an attacker vaultId.

authenticatorDataCases.name: uv-set
authenticatorDataCases.description: Flags UP|UV (0x05): PRF output may be used.

authenticatorDataCases.name: truncated
authenticatorDataCases.description: 36 bytes: too short to hold flags and signCount.

vaultIdDerivation.name: anvil-0-zero-salt
vaultIdDerivation.description: Anvil/Foundry default account 0 with the all-zero salt (Solidity fixture case 1).

vaultIdDerivation.name: typical-random
vaultIdDerivation.description: Arbitrary owner and salt (Solidity fixture case 2).

vaultIdDerivation.name: zero-owner-zero-salt
vaultIdDerivation.description: All-zero owner and salt; the id is still non-zero.

vaultIdDerivation.name: max-owner-zero-salt
vaultIdDerivation.description: Maximum owner with the all-zero salt.

vaultIdDerivation.name: zero-owner-max-salt
vaultIdDerivation.description: All-zero owner with the maximum salt.

vaultIdDerivation.name: salt-low-bit
vaultIdDerivation.description: Anvil account 0 with salt 0x00..01: one salt bit changes the id.

vaultIdDerivation.name: typical-det
vaultIdDerivation.description: Deterministic owner and salt from the vector labels.

vaultIdDerivation.name: typical-det-other-owner
vaultIdDerivation.description: Same salt as typical-det under another owner: a different id (no squatting).
